survey_bills_to_kwh

Source: R/technicals.R
survey_bills_to_kwh.Rd

a function that converts highest and lower bi-monthly bills from survey to daily D_max and D_min assuming a seasonal demand lag_D. D_max and D_min are used to estimate the financial return on pv bess investment. Missing data are imputed by default. An issue that needs to be addressed is "level pay". Stochastic.

survey_bills_to_kwh(data_in, lag_D = 30)

Arguments

data_in

survey data e.g. dep_survey

lag_D

seasonal lag in demand, default 30 days.

Examples

survey_bills_to_kwh(dep_survey,lag_D=30)
